description: CompressionMHL inner_dim=96 point of the inner_dim sweep (plain CompressionMultiHeadLUT, NO inner residual), PARAMETER-MATCHED to exp032 (35,792,640). Exact clone of exp036 (inner=64) except inner_dim=96 and tph re-chosen to param-match. PARAM MATCH: fixed compress(384*96+96=36,960)+decompress(96*384+384=37,248)=74,208/layer; FastMHL budget = 1,179,648-74,208 = 1,105,440 -> tph = 1,105,440/(2^6*96) = 179.9 -> tph=180 -> FastMHL 180*64*96 = 1,105,920; per-layer 1,180,128 (~=FFN 1,179,648, +480); total 35,795,520, delta +2,880 = +0.0080%. inner_residual=False. A/B vs exp036 inner=64 (1.40699). The dense 384->1536->384 GELU FFN is replaced ENTIRELY by a CompressionMHL bottleneck: compress Linear(384->inner) -> hard FastMultiHeadLut in the compressed inner space (input=output=inner) -> decompress Linear(inner->384). x = x + compressionmhl(h), h = ln2(x). No parallel dense linear, no GELU, no dense FFN. inner_dim=64, NAP=6, tph=276, n_heads=1, HARD forward, fp32 (use_bf16=False), near-zero table init (1e-3), per-layer anchor/init seed = 1000 + layer_idx; decompress weight zero-init'd for a residual-identity start. PARAM MATCH: per-layer = compress(384*64+64=24,640) + FastMHL(1*276*64*64=1,130,496) + decompress(64*384+384=24,960) = 1,180,096 ~= removed FFN 1,179,648 (+448/layer). tph=276 chosen so total = 35,795,328, delta +2,688 = +0.0075% vs exp032 (with inner=64/NAP=6, FastMHL budget/layer = 1,179,648-49,600 = 1,130,048 -> tph = 1,130,048/(64*64) = 275.9 -> 276). The FFN slot ~= 0 at init. MATCHED 4096-step run vs exp032 (byte-identical everything else: MinimalGPT+RoPE, d384/6L/6H/seq512, device_bs 48, total_bs 24576, n_steps 4096, lr 3e-4, wd 0.1, warmup 0.1, eval_every 200, seed 1, vocab 32768, same data). Optimizer: FastMHL LUT-table weights in the NO-weight-decay AdamW group; compress/decompress weights -> wd group, biases -> no-wd; all other params grouped exactly as exp032. Compare vs exp032 1.39371, exp033 Linear||FastMHL 1.41430, exp034 Linear-only 1.47970, exp035 FastMHL-only 1.47106.
